fields.title: 📖 Do not return after me to kuffār
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Do not return after me as kuffār, by some of you striking the necks of the others.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The path of the ghulāt does not end at mere slogans, but often at division, bloodshed and the desecration of the Muslims.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Bukhārī, Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb al-Fitan, Bāb: Qawl an-Nabī ﷺ lā tarjiʿū baʿdī kuffāran, Hadith Nr. 7077.
